name: tokenId
label: Token id
description: The unique key suffix to be added to '--now-animation-custom-' to enable style design token creation, that will contain the animation JSON

name: src
label: Animation source path
description: Source (path) from where the animation would be displayed

name: autoplay
label: Autoplay
description: It is used to control whether the animation starts playing automatically when it's loaded

name: loop
label: Loop
description: loop property controls whether the animation should repeat continuously or play only once
